14/S0.subgoal: Explain the purpose and concept of full-body tracking as a non-hand input device.

14/S1.subgoal: Describe the two primary approaches for full-body tracking: motion capture suits and camera-based systems.

14/S2.subgoal: Describe sound and voice tracking as an input method for VR.

14/S3.subgoal: Describe the role and hardware requirements of the processing element in a VR system.

14/S4.subgoal: Explain the different types of visual displays used in XR, including HMDs, world-fixed displays, and regular displays.

14/S5.subgoal: Describe how audio output systems provide spatial sound in VR.

14/S6.subgoal: Categorize and describe the various types of haptic feedback systems (tactile, proprioceptive, passive, active, self-grounded, and world-grounded).

14/S7.subgoal: Describe motion platforms and treadmills as physical motion output devices for VR.

14/S8.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
